FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Cedar Creek Medical & Dental Care operates as a comprehensive healthcare facility dedicated to providing high-quality medical and dental services to the local community. Our team consists of healthcare professionals, including dentists, dental hygienists, medical doctors, and nurses, who are committed to patient safety and compliance with regulatory standards. We ensure that all staff undergo regular training on hazardous material handling, emergency procedures, and updated safety protocols. 

Our office is equipped with modern examination and treatment rooms, complete with adequate ventilation systems for the storage and use of disinfectants, anesthetics, and sterilizing agents, which helps to prevent any buildup of toxic fumes. Additionally, we employ robust security measures, including an alarm system, to safeguard our premises, especially as we are located in a suburban area. 

Patient records are securely stored to comply with data privacy regulations, and we conduct regular risk assessments to identify and mitigate any potential hazards. Furthermore, we have established relationships with reliable vendors for supplies and pharmaceuticals, ensuring the quality and safety of our services. Cedar Creek Medical & Dental Care is committed to maintaining a clean claims history by adhering strictly to operational protocols and ensuring that all cosmetic or medical procedures are performed by qualified professionals.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On January 10, 2023, a water leak from the ceiling caused minor damage to the reception area flooring and wall. The total amount for repairs was $2,000. The claim was submitted and has been resolved with payment received.
FIELDS.Combined Single Limit: $1,000,000 combined single limit with a $2,500 deductible
